name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Anna Moon and David Moon, married three years by the time you arrived. She was an engineer, he was an architect. Nothing extravagant, but nobody checked the price of things. You were the youngest of 3: Mary and Andrew were already running the house. Your mother Anna never left the house without her face on, and taught you the same. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Anna Moon and David Moon — a comfortable household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.

scene.title: Paper Cousin
scene.line: The writer is on a plane and three lines are missing off the page. Rosalind Varga says do what you think.
